SPIRITUAL MERIT AND WEALTH ARE CALLED “ GOOD’; OR

In a friendly spirit, the Author now -proceeds to explain

(1) Some people have held that spiritual mer “it and

‘ Aggregate of three’ ;—i.e., a group consisting of three
